headline: DeepSeek's open V4 models spread power — Libertarian Utopia rises
body: Open models were the story. DeepSeek released its V4 models under a permissive MIT license, with near-frontier benchmark results and support for Huawei's Ascend chips. When strong AI is freely available, power is less concentrated, so Power Concentration fell. That helps Libertarian Utopia and Egalitarian Utopia, and hurts endings built on one controlling power, such as 1984, Benevolent Dictator and Enslaved God. In Maine, the governor vetoed the data-center moratorium passed ten days earlier, promising a study council instead, a small easing of Tech Backlash. Horizon Balance rose to +1.93, up 0.16.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.3, 1984 -0.3 and Benevolent Dictator -0.3, all from DeepSeek's open V4 release (+0.34, -0.31 and -0.28).
